PART II: ADMINISTRATION AND MANAGEMENT OF AFFAIRS OF THE BUREAU

5.
(1) The administration, management and control of
the  affairs  of  the  Bureau  shall  be  vested  in  a  Governing
Council (in this Act referred to as the “Council”).
(2) The Council shall, for the purpose of administering
the affairs of the Bureau, exercise, perform and discharge the
powers,  duties  and  functions  conferred  on,  assigned  to  or
imposed on the Bureau by this Act.
